# `silk/text/regex_unicode`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Unicode 17.0.0 property and simple-fold tables used by the ECMAScript regex parser.

## Details
Property aliases are exact and case-sensitive. Only ECMA-262 Table 65/66 properties are
accepted. Data comes from https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/ under Unicode License v3.

Public declarations: 5.

<a id="lookup"></a>

## `lookup`

```silk
pub fn lookup(kind: usize, name: string) -> usize
```

Resolves an exact Unicode alias; kind 0 is lone/binary, 1 category, 2 script, 3 extensions.
Zero means that the alias is not permitted in ECMAScript Unicode mode.

<a id="contains"></a>

## `contains`

```silk
pub fn contains(id: usize, cp: u32) -> bool
```

Tests one Unicode code point against a property ID returned by `lookup`.

<a id="equivalent"></a>

## `equivalent`

```silk
pub fn equivalent(cp: u32, index: usize) -> u32
```

Returns member `index` of the scalar's simple-fold equivalence class, or U+110000 at its end.
